title: HomeStar
description: HomeStar is a modern and powerful homes management plugin for Paper 1.21+, designed to provide players with a smooth, intuitive, and visually polished teleportation experience.
body:
![HomeStar Plugin Showcase](https://i.imgur.com/b6n2gkw.gif)

# HomeStar — Advanced Homes System

**HomeStar** is a modern, powerful, and highly customizable homes management plugin built for Paper 1.21.11.
It provides an immersive and intuitive way for players to create, manage, and teleport to their homes using a fully animated GUI, interactive chat messages, and advanced teleportation effects.

Designed with performance, scalability, and visual quality in mind, HomeStar is ideal for Survival, SMP, and Network servers that want a premium-quality home system.

---

## Features

* Fully animated homes GUI
* Player head icons for each home
* Create, delete, rename, favorite, and teleport to homes
* Public homes system
* Favorites category
* Pagination support
* Interactive clickable chat messages
* Beautiful colors and Unicode icons
* Permission-based home limits
* Cooldowns and teleport delay
* Teleport cancel on movement or damage
* BossBar teleport progress
* Sounds, particles, titles, and subtitles
* SQLite & MySQL support
* Async database operations
* In-memory cache
* PlaceholderAPI support
* Vault permissions support
* Highly configurable
* Optimized and production-ready

---

## Commands

```
/home
/home <name>
/sethome <name>
/delhome <name>
/renamehome <old> <new>
/homes

/phome
/phome <player>
/setpublichome <name>
/delpublichome <name>

/homestar reload
/homestar clear <player>
```

---

## Permissions

```
homestar.use
homestar.admin

homestar.limit.1
homestar.limit.5
homestar.limit.10
homestar.limit.25
homestar.limit.50
homestar.limit.unlimited
```

---

## GUI System

* Custom inventory layout
* Glass pane borders
* Home icons as player heads
* Home information:

  * World
  * Coordinates
  * Creation date
  * Favorite status
* Navigation buttons
* Action buttons:

  * Teleport
  * Delete
  * Rename
  * Favorite
  
---

## Public Homes

* Share homes publicly
* Separate GUI for public homes
* Teleport to other players' public homes
* Permission-based access

---

## Integrations

* PlaceholderAPI
* Vault

---

## Security & Stability

* Input validation
* Anti-duplicate protection
* Anti-crash protections
* Safe async handling
* Exploit prevention

---

## Installation

1. Download the plugin
2. Place it in `/plugins`
3. Restart the server
4. Edit configs
5. Use `/homestar reload`
